scraped.scraped_description: Your self-hosted, globally interconnected microblogging community - mastodon/mastodon

name: Mastodon
tagline: Your self-hosted, globally interconnected microblogging community
sdg_alignment: SDG 16: Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
dependency_risks: loss of non-profit status in Germany (occurred 2021-2025)
news_articles: Guardian: 'Mastodon: the Twitter alternative that's booming' (2022)
Wired: 'Mastodon Is Twitter's Biggest Competitor Yet' (2022)
Reuters: 'Elon Musk's Twitter changes fuel interest in Mastodon' (2022)
TechCrunch: 'Mastodon's growth shows the appetite for Twitter alternatives' (2022)
BBC: 'Mastodon: The decentralised social network gaining users' (2023)
NPR: 'What is Mastodon? A beginner's guide to the Twitter alternative' (2023)
academic_citations: Zulli & Zulli (2020) 'Extending the Internet meme: Conceptualizing technological mimesis and imitation publics on the rise of Instagram' - references decentralized social media
Gillespie (2010) 'The politics of platforms' - foundational work on platform governance applicable to Mastodon
Gillespie (2018) 'Custodians of the Internet' - discusses platform moderation relevant to federated systems
Suzor (2019) 'Lawless: The Secret Rules That Govern Our Digital Lives' - examines platform governance models
Roberts (2019) 'Behind the Screen: Content Moderation in the Shadows of Social Media' - relevant to Mastodon's distributed moderation
awards: EFF recognition for decentralized social media advocacy (2023)
policy_outcomes: Influenced EU Digital Services Act discussions on platform alternatives
Referenced in policy discussions on decentralized social media governance
Contributed to broader conversations on digital public infrastructure
outcome_methodology: observational - user adoption and instance growth metrics tracked; no randomized controlled trials
published_performance_metrics: GitHub activity metrics, instance count tracking (4,000+ instances as of 2025), user growth statistics published on mastodon.social
curation_criteria: Each instance sets its own moderation rules; no central curation
contributor_governance: Open source contributions via GitHub; core decisions by Mastodon Inc leadership; community governance process started 2025
disparity_tracking: Limited formal tracking; community discussions about accessibility and inclusion for marginalized users; no published equity metrics
community_ownership: Federated — individual instance operators own their servers; Mastodon Inc owns software trademark
controversies: Lost non-profit status in Germany when software projects were removed from eligibility
Criticism of slow feature development vs. competing fediverse projects
political_bias_allegations: Allegations of left-leaning bias in moderation practices on largest instances (mastodon.social); disputed by instance operators citing community standards rather than political ideology
legal_regulatory_issues: German non-profit status lapsed; new US 501(c)(3) entity Mastodon Inc established (EIN 92-3333630)
government_partnerships: EU institutions exploring Mastodon for official communications (2023-2024)
ai_involvement: No AI in core product as of 2026; AI-generated content moderation tools under community discussion
